name: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd
title: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd - 544239 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Asset-light corporate mobility grew trips 29% to 5.23m, but EBITDA margin fell to about 11.6% on ETS price competition and cost build; management guides 11-13% margin and 18-20% growth.

triggers.label: ETS competitive pricing pressure
triggers.quote: we have seen some competitive pressure over here, but we feel there is a certain threshold

triggers.label: Revenue growth 18-20% FY27
triggers.quote: we would look at is around an 18% to 20% growth in the coming year is what we can aspire to

triggers.label: Revenue per trip falling ~1,600 to 1,550
triggers.quote: So, last year it was around 1,600 and this year it is 1,550.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 11-13% guided
triggers.quote: we should be this year able to deliver anywhere between 11% to 13% in terms of EBITDA

guidance.quote: we would look at is around an 18% to 20% growth in the coming year is what we can aspire to
we should be this year able to deliver anywhere between 11% to 13% in terms of EBITDA
we would expect approximately, you know, anywhere between a 13% to 15% or 16% growth in the employee cost
Other expenses would stay around 8% to 9% increase, not more than that.

red_flags.label: Revenue per trip down ~3% while trips up 29%
red_flags.quote: So, last year it was around 1,600 and this year it is 1,550.

red_flags.label: Rs8 crore doubtful debt provision, legal recovery
red_flags.quote: we made a one-time provision for doubtful debt of approximately INR80 million

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA down YoY, revenue flat QoQ
red_flags.quote: EBITDA for the quarter came in at INR241.53 million as compared to INR264.67 million in Q4 FY25
